document_api_meta.title: Get Live Room User Portraits
document_api_meta.env_desc: Returns user portrait indicators for the specified live room, including age, gender, fan, advertisement, and region distributions.

request_header_param.name: x-tts-access-token
request_header_param.desc: The creator access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 1. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a362dccb8030ea6f98c) to get creator access_token.

request_query_param.name: app_key
request_query_param.desc: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

request_query_param.name: sign
request_query_param.desc: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

request_query_param.name: timestamp
request_query_param.desc: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

response_param.name: code
response_param.desc: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

response_param.name: message
response_param.desc: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

response_param.name: request_id
response_param.desc: Request log

response_param.name: data
response_param.desc: Specific return information

response_param.name: ^all_ads_gender_indicators
response_param.desc: Gender indicators for advertisement

response_param.name: ^^type
response_param.desc:
The gender category represented by this indicator.
Possible values:
- USER_PORTRAIT_GENDER_UNKNOWN: Unknown gender.
- USER_PORTRAIT_GENDER_M: Male.
- USER_PORTRAIT_GENDER_F: Female.

response_param.name: ^^value
response_param.desc: The count for the corresponding gender indicator.

response_param.name: ^all_fan_indicators
response_param.desc: Fans indicators

response_param.name: ^^type
response_param.desc:
The stats_type describes the type of value below.

USER_PORTRAIT_FOLLOWER: The user portrait of the follower

USER_PORTRAIT_NON_FOLLOWER: The user portrait of the non follower

response_param.name: ^^value
response_param.desc: The count for the corresponding follower-status indicator.

response_param.name: ^all_ads_age_indicators
response_param.desc: Age indicators for advertisement

response_param.name: ^^type
response_param.desc:
The type of age indicator.
USER_PORTRAIT_AGE_LESS_THAN_15: Users whose age is less than 15.
USER_PORTRAIT_AGE_MORE_THAN_34: Users whose age is more than 34.
USER_PORTRAIT_AGE_MORE_THAN_55: Users whose age is more than 55.
USER_PORTRAIT_AGE_13_TO_17: Users whose age is between 13 and 17.
USER_PORTRAIT_AGE_15_TO_17: Users whose age is between 15 and 17.
USER_PORTRAIT_AGE_18_TO_24: Users whose age is between 18 and 24.
USER_PORTRAIT_AGE_25_TO_34: Users whose age is between 25 and 34.
USER_PORTRAIT_AGE_35_TO_44: Users whose age is between 35 and 44.
USER_PORTRAIT_AGE_45_TO_54: Users whose age is between 45 and 54.

response_param.name: ^^value
response_param.desc: The count for the corresponding age indicator.

response_param.name: ^region_indicators
response_param.desc: Country-level user portrait indicators for the live room.

response_param.name: ^^value
response_param.desc: The share for the corresponding indicator, scaled by 10,000. Divide by 10,000 to obtain the underlying proportion.

response_param.name: ^^type
response_param.desc: The country of indicators

response_param.name: ^paid_ads_age_indicators
response_param.desc: Paid advertisement age indicators for advertisement

response_param.name: ^^type
response_param.desc:
The type of paid advertisement age indicator.
USER_PORTRAIT_AGE_LESS_THAN_15: Users whose age is less than 15.
USER_PORTRAIT_AGE_MORE_THAN_34: Users whose age is more than 34.
USER_PORTRAIT_AGE_MORE_THAN_55: Users whose age is more than 55.
USER_PORTRAIT_AGE_13_TO_17: Users whose age is between 13 and 17.
USER_PORTRAIT_AGE_15_TO_17: Users whose age is between 15 and 17.
USER_PORTRAIT_AGE_18_TO_24: Users whose age is between 18 and 24.
USER_PORTRAIT_AGE_25_TO_34: Users whose age is between 25 and 34.
USER_PORTRAIT_AGE_35_TO_44: Users whose age is between 35 and 44.
USER_PORTRAIT_AGE_45_TO_54: Users whose age is between 45 and 54.

response_param.name: ^^value
response_param.desc: The count for the corresponding paid-advertising age indicator.

response_param.name: ^paid_ads_gender_indicators
response_param.desc: Paid advertisement gender indicators for advertisement

response_param.name: ^^type
response_param.desc:
The gender category represented by this indicator.
Possible values:
- USER_PORTRAIT_GENDER_UNKNOWN: Unknown gender.
- USER_PORTRAIT_GENDER_M: Male.
- USER_PORTRAIT_GENDER_F: Female.

response_param.name: ^^value
response_param.desc: The count for the corresponding paid-advertising gender indicator.

response_param.name: ^paid_fan_indicators
response_param.desc: Paid fans indicators

response_param.name: ^^type
response_param.desc:
The stats_type describes the type of value below.

USER_PORTRAIT_FOLLOWER: The user portrait of the follower

USER_PORTRAIT_NON_FOLLOWER: The user portrait of the non follower

response_param.name: ^^value
response_param.desc: The count for the corresponding paid follower-status indicator.
